about_text: Computer Science undergraduate at IIIT Nagpur with proven experience in talent coordination, resource planning, cross-functional collaboration, and data analysis. Google Student Ambassador, GDG Co-Lead, and founder of a student organisation. Brings extreme ownership, a seeker mindset, and passionate work ethic to every role.

experience.title: Product Intern @ The Global Church Initiative
experience.description: Contributed to product planning, task execution, and cross-functional project delivery. Recognised by the CEO for strong commitment, professionalism, and on-time delivery of responsibilities.

experience.title: Google Student Ambassador, IIIT Nagpur
experience.description: Planned and executed structured outreach initiatives, coordinated resources, and aligned campus talent with Google programme goals while maintaining regular stakeholder communication.

experience.title: Co-Lead, Google Developer Group (GDG)
experience.description: Coordinated across design, logistics, content, and outreach sub-teams; managed talent allocation and resource planning. Analysed post-event participation data to identify trends and forecast resource needs.

experience.title: Hospitality Co-Lead, Abhivyakti Cultural Fest
experience.description: Managed talent allocation and demand forecasting for a 1000+ attendee event. Coordinated across five departments and maintained accurate operational documentation.

experience.title: Founder and 1st Lead, Synergy Esports Club
experience.description: Founded the club from zero. Structured teams, defined roles by strength, managed onboarding, and tracked engagement data to identify talent gaps.

projects.title: HR Management System, SaaS Platform
projects.description: Product Lead. Led requirement analysis and resource planning; identified bottlenecks, realigned talent allocation, and tracked KPIs across Agile sprints.

projects.title: FloatChat, AI Data Platform
projects.description: Smart India Hackathon 2025. Mapped individual strengths to workstreams, coordinated cross-functional delivery under competition constraints.

projects.title: Clay  GTM CaseStudy
projects.description:
GTM job postings surged 5,000% last year — most leaders still can't define the role.
I broke down how Clay hit a $5B valuation by replacing traditional sales with GTM Engineering.
The secret? Two teams, not one — an internal pipeline engine and a forward-deployed POC team running as a closed loop.
